description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


📖 Read the announcement blog post: https://tabularis.dev/blog/v0220-follow-system-theme-grid-selection-shortcuts-tiling-decorations?utm_src=github-release
See the assets below to download this version and install.
What's Changed
- feat: follow system light/dark appearance with per-mode theme selection by @iamthenuggetman in #650
- fix(postgres): use rustls connector in test_connection to support client certs and custom CA by @adisusilayasa in #678
- Hide native window decorations on tiling window managers by @debba in #680
- fix(notebook): address bugs in the frontend part of notebook feature by @harshavardhankonisa in #687
- fix(layout): keep pages inside main when the production banner is shown by @thomaswasle in #684
- feat(grid): spreadsheet-style keyboard selection and header column select by @debba in #683
- Relayout editor during resize by @DhruvShah-Dev in #657
- Remove tap step from Homebrew Cask installation documentation by @justsrc in #691
- fix(sqlite): display UTF-8 BLOB values as text by @debba in #696
- fix(ui): stable keys, useCopyFeedback hook, sanitize HTML, eliminate render-time setState by @harshavardhankonisa in #700
- fix(mysql): qualify SHOW CREATE routine with target schema by @debba in #701
New Contributors
- @harshavardhankonisa made their first contribution in #687
- @justsrc made their first contribution in #691
Full Changelog: v0.21.0...v0.22.0
